001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.json;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.path.JSONPath;
005import java.io.BufferedReader;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.InputStreamReader;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
011import java.io.Writer;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013
014/**
015 * JSON Filter Command Class
016 *
017 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from JSON using JSONPath expressions. Unlike
018 * JsonNavigateCommand which applies transformations, JsonFilterCommand only extracts/filters data
019 * based on specified paths without any modifications.
020 *
021 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using JSONPath expressions - Preserve exact data types
022 * and structure of extracted elements - Memory-efficient processing for large JSON files - Support
023 * for simple path expressions
024 */
025public class JsonFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
026
027  private static final int BUFFER_SIZE = 8192; // 8KB buffer for streaming
028  private static final int MAX_MEMORY_BUFFER = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB max buffer
029
030  private final JSONPath jsonPath;
031
032  // Deprecated fields for backward compatibility
033  @Deprecated private final String legacyJsonPath;
034
035  /**
036   * Constructor for JSON filtering with JSONPath selector.
037   *
038   * @param jsonPath the JSONPath expression to extract data (e.g., "$.users", "$.name")
039   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null or empty
040   * @deprecated Use {@link #JsonFilterCommand(JSONPath)} instead
041   */
042  @Deprecated
043  public JsonFilterCommand(String jsonPath) {
044    if (jsonPath == null || jsonPath.trim().isEmpty()) {
045      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSONPath cannot be null or empty");
046    }
047    this.legacyJsonPath = jsonPath.trim();
048    this.jsonPath = new JSONPath(jsonPath.trim());
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Constructor for JSON filtering with typed JSONPath selector.
053   *
054   * @param jsonPath the typed JSONPath to extract data
055   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null
056   */
057  public JsonFilterCommand(JSONPath jsonPath) {
058    if (jsonPath == null) {
059      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSONPath cannot be null");
060    }
061    this.jsonPath = jsonPath;
062    this.legacyJsonPath = jsonPath.getPath();
063  }
064
065  @Override
066  protected String getCommandDetails() {
067    return String.format("JsonFilterCommand(jsonPath='%s')", jsonPath.getPath());
068  }
069
070  @Override
071  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
072      throws IOException {
073    try (BufferedReader reader =
074            new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
075        Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
076
077      // Read JSON content efficiently
078      String jsonContent = readJsonContent(reader);
079
080      if (jsonContent.trim().isEmpty()) {
081        writer.write("null");
082        writer.flush();
083        return;
084      }
085
086      try {
087        // Apply simple JSONPath-like extraction using lightweight parsing
088        String result = extractJsonValue(jsonContent, jsonPath.getPath());
089        writer.write(result);
090        writer.flush();
091
092      } catch (Exception e) {
093        // If extraction fails, return null
094        writer.write("null");
095        writer.flush();
096      }
097    }
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Read JSON content from reader with memory management
102   *
103   * @param reader the BufferedReader to read from
104   * @return JSON content as string, or empty string if no content
105   * @throws IOException if reading fails
106   */
107  private String readJsonContent(BufferedReader reader) throws IOException {
108    StringBuilder jsonBuilder = new StringBuilder();
109    char[] buffer = new char[BUFFER_SIZE];
110    int totalCharsRead = 0;
111    int charsRead;
112
113    while ((charsRead = reader.read(buffer)) != -1) {
114      totalCharsRead += charsRead;
115
116      // Memory protection: prevent reading excessively large JSON into memory
117      if (totalCharsRead > MAX_MEMORY_BUFFER) {
118        throw new IOException(
119            "JSON content too large for filtering. Use streaming NavigateCommand instead.");
120      }
121
122      jsonBuilder.append(buffer, 0, charsRead);
123    }
124
125    return jsonBuilder.toString(); // Return empty string instead of null
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Extract JSON value using simple JSONPath-like expressions
130   *
131   * @param jsonContent the JSON content string
132   * @param path the JSONPath expression (simplified)
133   * @return extracted value as JSON string
134   */
135  private String extractJsonValue(String jsonContent, String path) {
136    // Handle root path
137    if ("$".equals(path)) {
138      return jsonContent.trim();
139    }
140
141    // Simple property extraction: $.property
142    if (path.startsWith("$.") && !path.contains("[") && path.indexOf(".", 2) == -1) {
143      String property = path.substring(2);
144      return extractSimpleProperty(jsonContent, property);
145    }
146
147    // For complex paths, return the original content for now
148    // In a full implementation, you would add array indexing, nested properties, etc.
149    return jsonContent.trim();
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * Extract a simple property from JSON content
154   *
155   * @param jsonContent JSON string
156   * @param property property name to extract
157   * @return property value as JSON string or "null" if not found
158   */
159  private String extractSimpleProperty(String jsonContent, String property) {
160    String searchPattern = "\"" + property + "\":";
161    int propertyStart = jsonContent.indexOf(searchPattern);
162
163    if (propertyStart == -1) {
164      return "null"; // Property not found
165    }
166
167    // Find the start of the value
168    int colonIndex = propertyStart + searchPattern.length();
169    int valueStart = colonIndex;
170    while (valueStart < jsonContent.length()
171        && Character.isWhitespace(jsonContent.charAt(valueStart))) {
172      valueStart++;
173    }
174
175    if (valueStart >= jsonContent.length()) {
176      return "null";
177    }
178
179    // Extract the value based on its type
180    char firstChar = jsonContent.charAt(valueStart);
181
182    if (firstChar == '"') {
183      // String value
184      return extractQuotedString(jsonContent, valueStart);
185    } else if (firstChar == '{') {
186      // Object value
187      return extractJsonObject(jsonContent, valueStart);
188    } else if (firstChar == '[') {
189      // Array value
190      return extractJsonArray(jsonContent, valueStart);
191    } else {
192      // Number, boolean, or null
193      return extractSimpleValue(jsonContent, valueStart);
194    }
195  }
196
197  private String extractQuotedString(String json, int start) {
198    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
199    result.append('"');
200    int i = start + 1; // Skip opening quote
201
202    while (i < json.length()) {
203      char c = json.charAt(i);
204      if (c == '"' && (i == start + 1 || json.charAt(i - 1) != '\\')) {
205        result.append('"');
206        break;
207      }
208      result.append(c);
209      i++;
210    }
211
212    return result.toString();
213  }
214
215  private String extractJsonObject(String json, int start) {
216    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
217    int braceCount = 0;
218
219    for (int i = start; i < json.length(); i++) {
220      char c = json.charAt(i);
221      result.append(c);
222
223      if (c == '{') braceCount++;
224      else if (c == '}') braceCount--;
225
226      if (braceCount == 0) break;
227    }
228
229    return result.toString();
230  }
231
232  private String extractJsonArray(String json, int start) {
233    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
234    int bracketCount = 0;
235
236    for (int i = start; i < json.length(); i++) {
237      char c = json.charAt(i);
238      result.append(c);
239
240      if (c == '[') bracketCount++;
241      else if (c == ']') bracketCount--;
242
243      if (bracketCount == 0) break;
244    }
245
246    return result.toString();
247  }
248
249  private String extractSimpleValue(String json, int start) {
250    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
251
252    for (int i = start; i < json.length(); i++) {
253      char c = json.charAt(i);
254      if (c == ',' || c == '}' || c == ']' || Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
255        break;
256      }
257      result.append(c);
258    }
259
260    return result.toString();
261  }
262}
